findings.text: The docstring calls the extracted code "the primitive definition" and "the transition" and does not name the boundaries, so the reader can't tell which declaration must stay last or which line closes the span without reading the code; the review finding that this commit resolves asked for those names. Fix: say that the function copies the text from `def step` up to the last `end SqliteVerifier` in `Execution.lean`, and warn that `step` must stay the last declaration in that namespace.
